verdict.rationale: Stripe ships an official CLI ("Build, test, and manage your Stripe integration from the command line") and explicitly documents headless, no-login sandbox provisioning for coding agents ("stripe sandbox create --help" with working API keys, no account registration required), plus API-key auth and idempotency keys for safe automated/retried calls — all core requirements for CI-style headless automation. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD pipeline examples (e.g. GitHub Actions integration) and non-interactive auth/login flow documentation beyond sandbox key issuance.
